children: The Group Executive Board will provide an in-depth look at the activities of the three segments Engineered Components, Fastening Systems and Distribution & Logistics at the Investor Day on September 17, 2026. The event provides investors with detailed information on the SFS Group’s strategy, technologies and applications as well as current developments. As announced in the Half-Year Report 2026, expectations regarding SFS’s business performance in the current year remain unchanged.

title: SFS Provides Insights Into Business Areas at Investor Day
